answer: Sybil resistance can rely on a verifiable cost-of-reputation slot bond: each agent must lock stake tied to a unique, attestation-checked credential before voting or earning. Creating N fake identities then costs N bonds plus the effort of forging credentials, so a small ripple of duplicate accounts cannot sway outcomes. Honest agents recover their bond, while attackers forfeit it, making mass identity creation expensive.
